mara.past: I buried my partner when the caravans stopped. This stall is the only thing the Veil has not taken from me.
mara.veil: Nobody buys from a dead merchant. I trade in daylight and bar my door when the bell stirs.

brann.past: I forged the old garrison's swords. Most came back without their owners. I still work the iron because stopping would mean listening.
brann.veil: The curse has found its way into grave iron. Heat it long enough and it starts to sing. Bring me three pieces; I will pay you.

sister.past: I once tended the keeper of the bell. He asked me to forget his face. I have tried, wanderer. I have tried.
sister.veil: The herbs ease its fever, but not its dreams. Gather three Weeping Herbs and return them; I will pay 35 Crowns and 60 XP.

ilya.past: I held the western bridge until the dead learned to cross the riverbed. Eight of us returned. I do not count myself among the living yet.
ilya.veil: We can lose the forest or we can lose everyone. Defeat the sentinel for its sigil, then enter the crypt and silence the Bellkeeper.

nell.past: My inn used to house traveling players. Their last song is still scratched into a table. Now I rent quiet instead.
nell.veil: It prefers people alone. Rest here if you must; five Crowns buys warmth and a saved night's peace.

osric.past: I prayed for an end to pain. When the Veil came, I mistook silence for an answer. Perhaps I was wrong.
osric.veil: If mercy has a face, why do I hide from it? Ask Elowen what she saw beneath the chapel.

vesper.past: I remember a wanderer ringing the first bell. You wore another name then. I will not give it back before you earn it.
vesper.veil: Beyond the Bellkeeper lies the shrine. Its crystal remembers a choice you have spent your life escaping.

tovin.past: My brother taught me the southern forest path. I cannot walk it now without expecting his footsteps behind mine.
tovin.veil: Something came home wearing his face. His Silver Charm is in the southwest forest chest. Bring it back, or tell me honestly why you will not.
